confirmed_causes: Visible frame claim did not reach actual internal controller.
Native GUI used nearest POI instead of FrameData.mainPos.
Live menu checked distance/block but not current team/stage; dynamic context re-resolves current BE and must not replace original inventory identity.
Native Default/Double logic advances while unlit and duration1 could complete before fuel cost.
Native selector queue could choose another overlapping second-lane recipe and reset paid work.
Native same-item merge ignores components; second lane reset on full destination can erase paid work.
Native cooking NBT has no historical recipe fingerprint; legacy progress cannot be automatically adopted.
limits: Capability forwarding through frame is commented out upstream; no automatic external IO claim.
Recipe codec hashes are not a complete transitive tag/registry fingerprint.
Historical residue definitions across restart are not established.
Changed/corrupt/legacy work is paused and preserved; explicit operator cancellation is not a refund.
No universal rollback after native/addon exceptions; a blocked lane can pause the whole checked cycle.
Global hot-path TPS was not benchmarked; selector is bounded to current native recipes/two lanes/26structure blocks.
